name: Fight For Survival
desc:
👍 LIKE FOR MORE UPDATES

A game about obliterating others using different abilities and powers. Hit players off the arena, increase your power, progress your abilities and collect multiple achievements all to become the strongest fighter in FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL!

Premium users receive 1.15x more power!

Available on PC & Mobile 🖥️📱

Controls:
- SHIFT to sprint
- CTRL for mouse lock
- G to emote (or the button in the top left)

Join the group for future rewards!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/32834123/Project-Survival 

Inspired by Ability Wars, Slap Battles and battlegrounds fighting games!

FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL UPDATE 4
